response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_average FROM media_averages) SELECT m.media_type_name, m.average_bytes_per_millisecond, m.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.overall_average AS amount_above_overall_average FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.overall_average;
